explanation: Implement only restage. Preserve the acknowledged lift, partial tilt and frame-324 state, retire the diverging fixed-pivot target, and freshly compare the visible carton end/face with actual hand motion since frame 306. Move with the achieved orientation: first raise, then translate to the central bowl workspace. Only there, and only if the measured fit requires it, attempt one compensated object-centered attitude change, not another rate-only retry at the old pivot. Fresh independent end landmarks and a depth-fitted face replace perimeter tracking; current bowl marks or a newly measured opening provide bounded alternatives. Uncertainty-adjusted fit, observed differential retention, actual pose progress and an above-rim finger-opening option are required for stage_complete. No placement, opening, release or later-stage control is implemented.
interface: Python main(api), using only the supplied API, np, math and geo. Returns a JSON-compatible object with stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. Reads place.geometry and place.progress with their provenance; writes only restage.reference and restage.progress, using the two remaining checkpoint slots. References preserve current RGB-D geometry, historical dimension identities, measurement uncertainty and frame IDs. Progress preserves retired pending commands, actual entry state, whole-lease states, receipts, pending actions and differential tests. Maximum four observation reviews, three drive leases with respective caps 12, 28 and 16, and one alternate attitude attempt. The same stack continues across control slices. Measurement gaps return blocked; changed retention, failed new motion or failed achieved fit request replanning. Only a fresh supported restaging effect returns stage_complete.
jev_protocol: Each physical update goes through api.drive and real Jev. Exactly seven choice questions bind x,y,z,rx,ry,rz to their respective state.processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation selectors: negative decreases the world coordinate/rotation-vector component, positive increases it, and hold selects the deadband. The gripper question binds to objective.gripper; close preserves the current grasp command, open means opening only when requested, and keep preserves the previous command. This stage requests close exclusively. Features label the phase, measurement frame, carton uncertainty, fit margin, strategy and prohibition on release; host-supplied current robot residuals supply local pose feedback. Jev chooses directions and delivers its gripper choice unchanged; it neither measures geometry nor certifies retention. Numerical geometry and uncertainty are calculated from API measurements with geo helpers. Reached is only pose/delivery feedback. Fresh measured carton motion is compared against actual whole-lease hand transforms using geo.attachment_error and face-normal consistency, with resolvable displacement required. Fit reserves include object and bowl uncertainty, position tolerance and a rotation-induced lever allowance. Leases are finite, nonconvergence is not retried, and checkpoints precede every action. Missing depth or identity permits at most one different measurement per observation within the four-review total; no hidden corner recovery or mandatory tracker is required. Release remains unauthorized; the numerical opening corridor is a bounded proposal for the next stage to revalidate, not a measured open state or completion claim.
